# Image converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/image-converter/

Convert a browser-readable image to JPEG, PNG or WebP without uploading it. Choose a transparent format for logos or a compact photographic format for sharing.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Turn a large PNG photo into a JPEG at 90% quality, or keep a transparent logo as PNG.

## Limits and checks

JPEG does not preserve transparency. GIF and other animated inputs are exported as a single frame.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
